description.narrative: The Global Growth Green Institute (GGGI) project focuses on building the climate resilience and employability of youth in Jordan, of both men and women as equally as it is able, by enhancing their green skills and fostering environmental awareness. The theory of change is driven by the understanding that equipping underserved Youth with green entrepreneurship training by increasing their capacity for understanding environmental challenges (such as climate change, biodiversity loss, air and water pollution, resource depletion, waste management, specific to Jordan), alongside identifying Green Business opportunities and aiding in allowing space for particpatory development , (market research, green behaviour) can influence youth-led green business initiatives that create local jobs with local solutions strengthening inclusive green economic opportunities in underserved regions in Jordan and impact sustainable development goals.
